translation_notes: Context shim (context_shim.py): the package-level ns_rdf/ns_xsd/ns_distill/ns_rdfa of lib/pyRdfa/__init__.py, same IRIs; original.py imports them from the shim instead of `from . import`.

dcterms:date: Literal(utcnow().isoformat(), datatype=ns_xsd['dateTime']) -> {datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()}^^xsd:dateTime inside the +{ } island (the computed typed literal of the stratum). The driver freezes utcnow() for both sides.

dcterms:description keeps {Literal(full_msg)}: full_msg is msg when node is None, and msg may be None (rdflib Literal(None) = 'None'; a bare {full_msg} raises TypeError in ldpy 0.7.1 - verified by a killed mutant). The requestURI literal is {"%s" % context}: a quoted "{context}" does not interpolate (trap 6).

The six self.graph.bind(...) calls are KEPT: `@graph self.graph` adds the block's prefixes WITHOUT overwriting an existing binding, whereas bind() rebinds (ht -> ht1 when `ht` is already bound elsewhere, a graph created with bind_namespaces='none', a namespace already bound under another prefix). Dropping them failed the driver's second phase on three such graphs; the call and its Namespace objects (ns_dc/ns_ht via `@prefix ... as`, ns_xsd/ns_rdf/ns_distill/ns_rdfa imported as objects) must survive.
ns_xsd and ns_rdfa are imported twice from the shim: as objects (for bind) and as prefixes (`ns_xsd: as xsd:`, `ns_rdfa: as rdfa:`) from an ordinary Python module. rdf:type is `a`.
Not covered by the driver: top_class=None (rdflib raises AssertionError, ldpy TypeError; the contract says URIRef).
optimization_notes: optimized.py: `isinstance(context, URIRef) or is_context_string` becomes `is_context_string` (URIRef is a str subclass, so it was already true); the description/date adds and the three rdfa:context adds become `self.graph += [...]`. The rdf:type add of top_class and the guarded info_class add stay separate and first, so a bad top_class or info_class raises with the same partial graph. The Python 2 try/except around basestring and the node.nodeName try/except are kept, as are the six bind calls (they rebind; @graph would not).
optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `@graph self.graph` after the binds, one +{ } per add group, {datetime...isoformat()}^^xsd:dateTime, {Literal(full_msg)} kept (msg may be None), {"%s" % context}.
header_optimization_notes: Python: sys and URIRef go; the four rdflib import lines become `from rdflib import BNode, Literal, Namespace`.
LD Python: sys, URIRef and Namespace go; the shim import (objects and prefixes) and both @prefix ... as lines are used.
